notes:
Refers to extracting milk from dairy animals (typically cows or goats) or expressing breast milk using a pump. The word is used in both agricultural and parenting contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {搾乳|さくにゅう}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: milking machine
- {搾乳|さくにゅう}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount of milk produced
- {搾乳|さくにゅう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: milking time
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧{搾|しぼ}り: hand milking (manual method)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{哺乳|ほにゅう}→哺乳：24166_honyuu⟧: nursing, suckling — the act of feeding milk to young, the opposite direction from {搾乳|さくにゅう}
- ⟦{授乳|じゅにゅう}→授乳：14937_junyuu⟧: breastfeeding — a mother feeding her baby; differs from {搾乳|さくにゅう} which focuses on extracting the milk
- ⟦{乳搾|ちちしぼ}り→乳搾り：29331_chichishibori⟧: milking — a more colloquial, rustic-sounding variant
